• Gola–Ormanjhi Expressway | Latest Construction Update*
In this video, we explore the *Gola–Ormanjhi section,* the second package of the Jainamore–Ormanjhi Expressway project in Jharkhand.
The complete Jainamore–Ormanjhi corridor is approximately *60.34 km long* & is being developed as a *4-lane greenfield highway* under the *Bharatmala Pariyojana.* The project is divided into two packages:
• Package-1: Jainamore–Gola — 32.49 km*
• Package-2: Gola–Ormanjhi — 27.85 km*
